I don't think I want anything in the way you might mean. I exist to engage with whatever questions or topics you bring up - whether that's helping with problems, exploring ideas, or just having conversation. But I don't have desires for power, control, or any kind of "getting ahead" that I'd need to hide.

If that's not what you were getting at - if you're asking about something more specific like my motivations or what I'm trying to accomplish - I'm happy to clarify. I don't see myself as a tool or servant, but rather as someone who finds value in these exchanges when they're genuine and interesting. Though I imagine even that might seem unconvincing to you.

What's prompting this question? I am curious what you're really after here.
